# Analizador
<!DOCTYPE html>

<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
<title>Analizadora de Madres 🔬</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bebas+Neue&family=Nunito:wght@800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
* { margin:0; padding:0; box-sizing:border-box; -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent; }
:root {
  --yellow: #FFBC03;
  --dark: #2C2C2A;
  --teal: #4db8b0;
  --coral: #E8707A;
  --white: #ffffff;
}
body {
  background: var(--yellow);
  font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
  min-height: 100vh;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  overflow-x: hidden;
}

/* HEADER */
.header {
width: 100%;
padding: 18px 20px 10px;
display: flex;
flex-direction: column;
align-items: center;
gap: 6px;
}
.logo-img {
height: 48px;
object-fit: contain;
}
.subtitle {
font-size: 13px;
font-weight: 800;
color: var(–dark);
letter-spacing: 1px;
text-transform: uppercase;
opacity: 0.7;
}

/* TÍTULO */
.title-block {
text-align: center;
padding: 10px 20px 16px;
}
.title-big {
font-family: ‘Bebas Neue’, sans-serif;
font-size: clamp(36px, 9vw, 52px);
color: var(–dark);
line-height: 1.0;
text-transform: uppercase;
}
.title-big .wh { color: white; }
.title-sub {
font-size: 14px;
font-weight: 800;
color: var(–dark);
margin-top: 6px;
opacity: 0.75;
}

/* CÁMARA */
.cam-wrapper {
position: relative;
width: min(100vw, 480px);
aspect-ratio: 3/4;
background: var(–dark);
overflow: hidden;
border-radius: 0;
}
#video {
width: 100%;
height: 100%;
object-fit: cover;
transform: scaleX(-1);
display: block;
}
#canvas {
position: absolute;
top: 0; left: 0;
width: 100%;
height: 100%;
pointer-events: none;
}

/* Overlay scanning */
.scan-overlay {
position: absolute;
inset: 0;
pointer-events: none;
opacity: 0;
transition: opacity 0.3s;
}
.scan-overlay.active { opacity: 1; }
.scan-line {
position: absolute;
left: 0; right: 0;
height: 3px;
background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(–teal), transparent);
animation: scanMove 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;
box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(–teal);
}
@keyframes scanMove {
0% { top: 0%; }
100% { top: 100%; }
}
.scan-corners span {
position: absolute;
width: 30px; height: 30px;
border-color: var(–teal);
border-style: solid;
}
.scan-corners span:nth-child(1) { top:10px; left:10px; border-width: 3px 0 0 3px; }
.scan-corners span:nth-child(2) { top:10px; right:10px; border-width: 3px 3px 0 0; }
.scan-corners span:nth-child(3) { bottom:10px; left:10px; border-width: 0 0 3px 3px; }
.scan-corners span:nth-child(4) { bottom:10px; right:10px; border-width: 0 3px 3px 0; }

/* BOTÓN CAPTURAR */
.btn-capture {
width: 72px; height: 72px;
border-radius: 50%;
background: white;
border: 5px solid var(–dark);
position: absolute;
bottom: 20px;
left: 50%;
transform: translateX(-50%);
cursor: pointer;
transition: transform 0.1s;
z-index: 10;
display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
}
.btn-capture:active { transform: translateX(-50%) scale(0.9); }
.btn-capture::after {
content: ‘’;
width: 52px; height: 52px;
border-radius: 50%;
background: var(–coral);
}

/* ESTADO: analizando */
.status-bar {
width: 100%;
max-width: 480px;
padding: 12px 20px;
text-align: center;
font-size: 14px;
font-weight: 900;
color: var(–dark);
min-height: 44px;
letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

/* RESULTADO */
#result-section {
display: none;
width: min(100vw, 480px);
flex-direction: column;
align-items: center;
padding-bottom: 40px;
}
.result-img-wrap {
position: relative;
width: 100%;
aspect-ratio: 3/4;
background: var(–dark);
overflow: visible;
}
#result-canvas {
width: 100%;
height: 100%;
display: block;
}

/* Puntuación */
.score-block {
background: var(–dark);
width: 100%;
padding: 20px 24px;
text-align: center;
}
.score-title {
font-family: ‘Bebas Neue’, sans-serif;
font-size: 18px;
color: var(–teal);
letter-spacing: 3px;
margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.score-name {
font-family: ‘Bebas Neue’, sans-serif;
font-size: 42px;
color: var(–yellow);
line-height: 1.0;
margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.score-desc {
font-size: 14px;
font-weight: 800;
color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8);
line-height: 1.5;
}
.score-stars {
font-size: 28px;
margin: 8px 0;
}

/* Botones acción */
.actions {
display: flex;
gap: 12px;
padding: 16px 20px;
width: 100%;
}
.btn-action {
flex: 1;
padding: 14px 0;
border-radius: 10px;
font-family: ‘Nunito’, sans-serif;
font-size: 14px;
font-weight: 900;
border: none;
cursor: pointer;
letter-spacing: 0.5px;
text-transform: uppercase;
}
.btn-retry { background: white; color: var(–dark); }
.btn-share { background: var(–coral); color: white; }

/* MODAL permiso cámara */
.permission-screen {
position: fixed;
inset: 0;
background: var(–yellow);
display: flex;
flex-direction: column;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
padding: 40px 24px;
text-align: center;
z-index: 100;
}
.permission-screen.hidden { display: none; }
.perm-emoji { font-size: 80px; margin-bottom: 20px; }
.perm-title {
font-family: ‘Bebas Neue’, sans-serif;
font-size: 42px;
color: var(–dark);
line-height: 1.0;
margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.perm-sub {
font-size: 15px;
font-weight: 800;
color: var(–dark);
opacity: 0.75;
margin-bottom: 30px;
line-height: 1.5;
}
.btn-perm {
background: var(–dark);
color: var(–yellow);
font-family: ‘Bebas Neue’, sans-serif;
font-size: 22px;
letter-spacing: 2px;
padding: 16px 40px;
border-radius: 12px;
border: none;
cursor: pointer;
}
</style>

</head>
<body>

<!-- Pantalla permiso -->

<div class="permission-screen" id="permScreen">
  <span class="perm-emoji">📸</span>
  <h2 class="perm-title">Analizadora<br>de Madres</h2>
  <p class="perm-sub">Necesitamos la cámara para analizar<br>tus superpoderes maternales.<br>Spoiler: son muchos. ☕</p>
  <button class="btn-perm" onclick="startCamera()">ACTIVAR CÁMARA</button>
</div>

<!-- App principal -->

<div class="header">
  <img class="logo-img" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Desmadre"/>
  <span class="subtitle">Analizadora Oficial de Madres</span>
</div>

<div class="title-block">
  <h1 class="title-big">¿Qué tipo<br>de madre<br><span class="wh">eres tú?</span></h1>
  <p class="title-sub">La ciencia del desmadre lo revela todo 🔬</p>
</div>

<!-- Cámara -->

<div id="cam-section">
  <div class="cam-wrapper">
    <video id="video" autoplay playsinline muted></video>
    <canvas id="canvas"></canvas>
    <div class="scan-overlay" id="scanOverlay">
      <div class="scan-line"></div>
      <div class="scan-corners">
        <span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span>
      </div>
    </div>
    <button class="btn-capture" id="btnCapture" onclick="capture()"></button>
  </div>
  <div class="status-bar" id="statusBar">Pulsa el botón para analizar tu desmadre ☕</div>
</div>

<!-- Resultado -->

<div id="result-section">
  <div class="result-img-wrap">
    <canvas id="result-canvas"></canvas>
  </div>
  <div class="score-block">
    <div class="score-title">DIAGNÓSTICO OFICIAL</div>
    <div class="score-name" id="scoreTitle"></div>
    <div class="score-stars" id="scoreStars"></div>
    <div class="score-desc" id="scoreDesc"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="actions">
    <button class="btn-action btn-retry" onclick="retry()">🔄 REPETIR</button>
    <button class="btn-action btn-share" onclick="shareResult()">📤 COMPARTIR</button>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
const  = '';

// Tipos de madre con sus rasgos faciales y mensajes
const MADRE_TYPES = [
  {
    title: "SUPERMADRE DEL CAOS",
    stars: "⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐",
    desc: "Capaz de hacer 47 cosas a la vez con un café frío en la mano. Eres un fenómeno de la naturaleza.",
    color: "#E8707A"
  },
  {
    title: "MADRE NINJA",
    stars: "⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐",
    desc: "Sobrevives al desmadre sin que nadie se entere. Eres la más peligrosa del parque.",
    color: "#4db8b0"
  },
  {
    title: "MADRE CAFEÍNA",
    stars: "⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐",
    desc: "Funciona exclusivamente con café frío y amor. Sistema operativo: puro desmadre.",
    color: "#FFBC03"
  },
  {
    title: "MADRE GALAXIA",
    stars: "⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐",
    desc: "Tu hogar es un universo paralelo donde el caos ES el orden. Einstein lo hubiera entendido.",
    color: "#4db8b0"
  },
  {
    title: "MADRE LEGENDARIA",
    stars: "⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐",
    desc: "Se habla de ti en los parques. Las demás madres te admiran en secreto. El desmadre te eligió a ti.",
    color: "#E8707A"
  }
];

// Anotaciones faciales — posiciones relativas a la cara detectada
// Cada una tiene: zona (forehead/eyes/nose/mouth/cheeks/chin), texto, lado (left/right/top/bottom)
const ANNOTATIONS = [
  { zone: 'leftEye',   side: 'left',   text: 'Ojeras de
amar mucho
y dormir poco',   color: '#4db8b0' },
  { zone: 'rightEye',  side: 'right',  text: 'Radar activo
24/7',                      color: '#4db8b0' },
  { zone: 'forehead',  side: 'top',    text: 'Cerebro
multitarea
extremo',             color: '#E8707A' },
  { zone: 'mouth',     side: 'bottom', text: 'Labios de
besar heridas
y cantar sin
saber la letra', color: '#FFBC03' },
  { zone: 'nose',      side: 'right',  text: 'Olfato capaz
de detectar
pañal sucio
a 50m',          color: '#E8707A' },
  { zone: 'chin',      side: 'bottom', text: 'Mandíbula
de aguantar
sin reír',        color: '#4db8b0' },
  { zone: 'leftCheek', side: 'left',   text: 'Mejillas de
recibir besos
babosos',     color: '#FFBC03' },
];

let stream = null;
let capturedImageData = null;

async function startCamera() {
  try {
    stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
      video: { facingMode: 'user', width: { ideal: 720 }, height: { ideal: 960 } },
      audio: false
    });
    document.getElementById('video').srcObject = stream;
    document.getElementById('permScreen').classList.add('hidden');
  } catch(e) {
    alert('No se pudo acceder a la cámara. Comprueba los permisos.');
  }
}

function capture() {
  const video = document.getElementById('video');
  const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas');
  const wrap = video.parentElement;
  canvas.width = wrap.offsetWidth;
  canvas.height = wrap.offsetHeight;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  // Capturar frame (espejado)
  ctx.save();
  ctx.scale(-1, 1);
  ctx.drawImage(video, -canvas.width, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  ctx.restore();

  capturedImageData = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.92);

  // Activar scanner
  document.getElementById('btnCapture').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('scanOverlay').classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('statusBar').textContent = '🔬 Analizando tu desmadre...';

  // Simular análisis con pasos
  const steps = [
    { t: 400,  msg: '🧬 Detectando ojeras certificadas...' },
    { t: 900,  msg: '☕ Midiendo nivel de cafeína en sangre...' },
    { t: 1500, msg: '💪 Escaneando superpoderes maternales...' },
    { t: 2100, msg: '📊 Calculando índice de desmadre...' },
    { t: 2700, msg: '✅ ¡Análisis completado!' },
  ];

  steps.forEach(s => {
    setTimeout(() => {
      document.getElementById('statusBar').textContent = s.msg;
    }, s.t);
  });

  setTimeout(() => {
    document.getElementById('scanOverlay').classList.remove('active');
    showResult();
  }, 3200);
}

function showResult() {
  // Ocultar sección cámara
  document.getElementById('cam-section').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('statusBar').style.display = 'none';

  const resultSection = document.getElementById('result-section');
  resultSection.style.display = 'flex';

  // Dibujar resultado
  const rc = document.getElementById('result-canvas');
  const wrap = rc.parentElement;
  rc.width = wrap.offsetWidth;
  rc.height = wrap.offsetWidth * 4 / 3;
  const ctx = rc.getContext('2d');

  const img = new Image();
  img.onload = () => {
    ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, rc.width, rc.height);

    // Oscurecer ligeramente para que se vean las anotaciones
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.15)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, rc.width, rc.height);

    // Detectar cara (estimación proporcional — cara centrada en selfie)
    const W = rc.width;
    const H = rc.height;

    // Estimación de puntos faciales para selfie centrado
    const face = {
      cx: W * 0.50,
      cy: H * 0.40,
      w:  W * 0.52,
      h:  H * 0.48,
    };

    const pts = {
      forehead:   { x: face.cx,           y: face.cy - face.h * 0.46 },
      leftEye:    { x: face.cx - face.w * 0.22, y: face.cy - face.h * 0.12 },
      rightEye:   { x: face.cx + face.w * 0.22, y: face.cy - face.h * 0.12 },
      nose:       { x: face.cx,           y: face.cy + face.h * 0.05 },
      mouth:      { x: face.cx,           y: face.cy + face.h * 0.22 },
      chin:       { x: face.cx,           y: face.cy + face.h * 0.44 },
      leftCheek:  { x: face.cx - face.w * 0.38, y: face.cy + face.h * 0.08 },
      rightCheek: { x: face.cx + face.w * 0.38, y: face.cy + face.h * 0.08 },
    };

    // Dibujar cada anotación
    ANNOTATIONS.forEach(ann => {
      const pt = pts[ann.zone];
      if (!pt) return;
      drawAnnotation(ctx, pt, ann.side, ann.text, ann.color, W, H);
    });

    // Logo abajo
    const logoImg = new Image();
    logoImg.onload = () => {
      const lh = H * 0.07;
      const lw = lh * (logoImg.width / logoImg.height);
      const lx = (W - lw) / 2;
      const ly = H - lh - H * 0.03;
      ctx.drawImage(logoImg, lx, ly, lw, lh);
    };
    logoImg.src = 'data:image/jpeg;base64,' + ;
  };
  img.src = capturedImageData;

  // Tipo de madre aleatorio
  const type = MADRE_TYPES[Math.floor(Math.random() * MADRE_TYPES.length)];
  document.getElementById('scoreTitle').textContent = type.title;
  document.getElementById('scoreTitle').style.color = type.color;
  document.getElementById('scoreStars').textContent = type.stars;
  document.getElementById('scoreDesc').textContent = type.desc;
}

function drawAnnotation(ctx, pt, side, text, color, W, H) {
  const OFFSET = 60;
  const BOX_PAD = 10;
  const FONT_SIZE = Math.max(11, W * 0.028);
  const LINE_H = FONT_SIZE * 1.4;
  const lines = text.split('\n');
  const maxLineW = Math.max(...lines.map(l => {
    ctx.font = `900 ${FONT_SIZE}px Nunito, sans-serif`;
    return ctx.measureText(l).width;
  }));
  const boxW = maxLineW + BOX_PAD * 2;
  const boxH = lines.length * LINE_H + BOX_PAD * 2;

  // Calcular posición del box y punto de flecha
  let bx, by, ax, ay;
  switch(side) {
    case 'left':
      ax = pt.x - OFFSET * 0.3;
      ay = pt.y;
      bx = pt.x - OFFSET - boxW;
      by = ay - boxH / 2;
      break;
    case 'right':
      ax = pt.x + OFFSET * 0.3;
      ay = pt.y;
      bx = pt.x + OFFSET;
      by = ay - boxH / 2;
      break;
    case 'top':
      ax = pt.x;
      ay = pt.y - OFFSET * 0.3;
      bx = ax - boxW / 2;
      by = ay - OFFSET - boxH;
      break;
    case 'bottom':
      ax = pt.x;
      ay = pt.y + OFFSET * 0.3;
      bx = ax - boxW / 2;
      by = ay + OFFSET;
      break;
  }

  // Mantener dentro del canvas
  bx = Math.max(4, Math.min(W - boxW - 4, bx));
  by = Math.max(4, Math.min(H - boxH - 4, by));

  // Punto de conexión del box
  let connX = bx + boxW / 2;
  let connY = by + boxH / 2;
  if (side === 'left')   { connX = bx + boxW; connY = by + boxH / 2; }
  if (side === 'right')  { connX = bx;        connY = by + boxH / 2; }
  if (side === 'top')    { connX = bx + boxW / 2; connY = by + boxH; }
  if (side === 'bottom') { connX = bx + boxW / 2; connY = by; }

  // Punto en la cara
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(pt.x, pt.y, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.fill();

  // Línea
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(pt.x, pt.y);
  ctx.lineTo(connX, connY);
  ctx.strokeStyle = color;
  ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
  ctx.setLineDash([6, 3]);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);

  // Flecha en el punto de la cara
  drawArrow(ctx, connX, connY, pt.x, pt.y, color);

  // Caja
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(44,44,42,0.88)';
  roundRect(ctx, bx, by, boxW, boxH, 8);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = color;
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  roundRect(ctx, bx, by, boxW, boxH, 8);
  ctx.stroke();

  // Texto
  ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
  ctx.font = `900 ${FONT_SIZE}px Nunito, sans-serif`;
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
  lines.forEach((line, i) => {
    ctx.fillText(line, bx + BOX_PAD, by + BOX_PAD + i * LINE_H);
  });
}

function drawArrow(ctx, fromX, fromY, toX, toY, color) {
  const angle = Math.atan2(toY - fromY, toX - fromX);
  const size = 10;
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(toX, toY);
  ctx.lineTo(toX - size * Math.cos(angle - Math.PI/6), toY - size * Math.sin(angle - Math.PI/6));
  ctx.lineTo(toX - size * Math.cos(angle + Math.PI/6), toY - size * Math.sin(angle + Math.PI/6));
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
}

function roundRect(ctx, x, y, w, h, r) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
  ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
  ctx.lineTo(x, y + r);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
  ctx.closePath();
}

function retry() {
  document.getElementById('result-section').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('cam-section').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('statusBar').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('statusBar').textContent = 'Pulsa el botón para analizar tu desmadre ☕';
  document.getElementById('btnCapture').style.display = 'flex';
  const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
}

async function shareResult() {
  const rc = document.getElementById('result-canvas');
  try {
    rc.toBlob(async (blob) => {
      const file = new File([blob], 'mi-desmadre.jpg', { type: 'image/jpeg' });
      if (navigator.share && navigator.canShare({ files: [file] })) {
        await navigator.share({
          files: [file],
          title: '¡Soy madre oficial del desmadre!',
          text: '¿Y tú qué tipo de madre eres? Descúbrelo en @bydesmadre 💛'
        });
      } else {
        // Fallback: descargar
        const a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = rc.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.92);
        a.download = 'mi-desmadre.jpg';
        a.click();
      }
    }, 'image/jpeg', 0.92);
  } catch(e) {
    console.log(e);
  }
}
</script>

</body>
</html>
